_about: 旁炉 · 炸炉 (rules/panglu.mjs; design.md § 丹药; story DESIGN § 六·五 「凡人丹炉十炉炸七」): the 丹房's side furnace 闵丹师 gives him in 09-laba (「料你自己碾，火你自己看。炼糊了，碾了做药引。」). A mortal furnace he tends himself — never the 饭桶's lottery (the 饭桶 is 老君's and never 炸s). It stands where a place `has.furnace` (the 丹房's scenes stand at the 药园, places/xu.json `yaoyuan`), open once `after` is done. One herb of `herbs` a batch (the 丹房's 下脚料 and the plain herbs of the hills — no shelf sells them); the rules roll the batch from `bands` (炸 · 糊 · 一转 · 二转), the band picked by how many batches this save has fired (`state.panglu.n`), seeded by the day, the save and that count, so firing again never re-rolls. `lesson`: the batch count at which 闵丹师 says 「首尾武，中间文」 — the step that lifts 二转 (no band before it has any). What each comes to is `outs` (糊 → 药引, a material); a 炸 gives nothing and costs the herb and a little 体力 (rewards.json stamina.cost `panglu`), nothing more. `per_day`: batches a local day (the book: 一个月不过三四炉). The agent's picks (Hanli delegated, 2026-10-31): the odds, `lesson` 8, `per_day` 2, one pill a batch.

zh.name: 旁炉
zh.line: 丹房角上那口小炉，炉壁裂过一道缝，拿泥糊上了。「料你自己碾，火你自己看。炼糊了，碾了做药引。」

results.zha: 「嘭」的一声，炉盖跳起半尺，一炉料全成了灰。你抹了一把脸上的黑。
results.hu: 三颗全糊了，黑乎乎一团。你把它碾了，做药引。
results.yi: 出了一颗{name}，青白，一道纹，歪歪扭扭的。

zh.lesson: 闵丹师在正炉那头闻了闻，头也不回：「火小了。」你道：「怕糊。」「怕糊，就一辈子一道纹。首尾武，中间文。」
zh.full: 今天的料碾完了，明天再来。
zh.no_herb: 炉边没有料——带一把草药来。
zh.not_here: 旁炉在丹房角上，不在这里。

en.name: The side furnace
en.line: The little furnace in the corner of the pill house, a crack in its wall patched with clay. "Grind your own herbs, watch your own fire. Burn it, grind it, use it to lead the next medicine."

results.zha: Bang — the lid jumps half a foot and the whole batch is ash. You wipe the soot off your face.
results.hu: All three burnt to a black lump. You grind it down for a medicine starter.
results.yi: One {name} comes out, pale, one ring, crooked.
results.er: One {name} comes out, two rings, straight.

en.lesson: From the main furnace Pill-master Min sniffs without turning round: "Your fire's too low." "I'm afraid of burning it." "Afraid of burning it, one ring all your life. Strong at both ends, gentle in the middle."
en.fired: You have fired this furnace {n} times.
en.full: Today's herbs are ground. Come back tomorrow.
en.no_herb: Nothing to put in — bring a handful of herbs.
en.not_here: The side furnace is in the corner of the pill house, not here.
en.not_herb: That will not go in this furnace.
